name: realtor-pipeline
description: Assistant agents for residential real estate agents. Leads: speed-to-lead replies, qualification, nurture, daily review. Clients: buyer consultations, home search, CMAs and listing presentations, listing copy, weekly seller reports. Deals: offer strategy, offer comparison, contract deadlines, repair requests, transaction status. Texas (TREC) compliance built in.

fub_api_key.title: Follow Up Boss API key (optional)
fub_api_key.description: Lets the assistant read and update your Follow Up Boss contacts, notes, and tasks. It asks you before every change. Create one in Follow Up Boss under Admin → API. Leave blank if you don't use Follow Up Boss.
